messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in Hindi, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 90 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in Hindi>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

content:
{"text": "नमस्ते अमृता जी, 

चौधरी सुपर मार्केट के लिए हमारे साउंडबॉक्स की पेशकश है। यह आपके लिए उपयोगी हो सकता है क्योंकि यह भुगतान की घोषणा करता है, जिससे आपको हर बार फोन चेक करने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। इसका मासिक किराया ₹99–199 (illus.) है। 

धन्यवाद, 
Merchant support team", "english": "Hello Amruta Ji,

We have an offer for a Soundbox for Chaudhuri Super Market. It could be useful for you as it announces payments, so you don't need to check your phone each time. The monthly rental is ₹99–199 (illus.).

Thank you,
Merchant support team"}
